service.description: Export posted ledger transactions in Tally-compatible XML (Day Book vouchers).

actions.script:
def vtMap = ['AttJournal':'Journal', 'AttSalesInvoice':'Sales', 'AttPurchaseInvoice':'Purchase', 'AttIncomingPayment':'Receipt', 'AttOutgoingPayment':'Payment', 'AttContra':'Contra'] def esc = { s -> (s ?: '').toString().replace('&','&').replace('<','<').replace('>','>') } def sb = new StringBuilder() sb.append('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
') sb.append('<ENVELOPE>
') sb.append(' <HEADER>
') sb.append(' <TALLYREQUEST>Import Data</TALLYREQUEST>
') sb.append(' </HEADER>
') sb.append(' <BODY>
') sb.append(' <IMPORTDATA>
') sb.append(' <REQUESTDESC>
') sb.append(' <REPORTNAME>Vouchers</REPORTNAME>
') sb.append(' <STATICVARIABLES>
') sb.append(' <SVCURRENTCOMPANY>' + esc(companyName ?: 'Company') + '</SVCURRENTCOMPANY>
') sb.append(' </STATICVARIABLES>
') sb.append(' </REQUESTDESC>
') sb.append(' <REQUESTDATA>
')
def acctNameCache = [:] journals?.each { journal -> def txnDate = ec.l10n.format(journal.transactionDate, 'yyyyMMdd') def voucherType = vtMap[journal.acctgTransTypeEnumId] ?: 'Journal'
sb.append(' <TALLYMESSAGE xmlns:UDF="TallyUDF">
') sb.append(' <VOUCHER VCHTYPE="' + voucherType + '" ACTION="Create">
') sb.append(' <DATE>' + txnDate + '</DATE>
') sb.append(' <VOUCHERTYPENAME>' + voucherType + '</VOUCHERTYPENAME>
') sb.append(' <VOUCHERNUMBER>' + esc(journal.voucherRef ?: journal.acctgTransId) + '</VOUCHERNUMBER>
') sb.append(' <NARRATION>' + esc(journal.description) + '</NARRATION>
')
def lines = ec.entity.find('mantle.ledger.transaction.AcctgTransEntry') .condition('acctgTransId', journal.acctgTransId).orderBy('acctgTransEntrySeqId').list()
lines?.each { line -> def acctName = acctNameCache[line.glAccountId] if (acctName == null) { def acct = ec.entity.find('mantle.ledger.account.GlAccount') .condition('glAccountId', line.glAccountId).one() acctName = acct ? (acct.accountName ?: acct.glAccountId) : line.glAccountId acctNameCache[line.glAccountId] = acctName } def amt = line.amount ?: 0 // Tally: debit => ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE Yes with a negative AMOUNT; credit => No with positive. if (line.debitCreditFlag == 'D') { sb.append(' <ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
') sb.append(' <LEDGERNAME>' + esc(acctName) + '</LEDGERNAME>
') sb.append(' <ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>Yes</ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>
') sb.append(' <AMOUNT>-' + amt + '</AMOUNT>
') sb.append(' </ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
') } else if (line.debitCreditFlag == 'C') { sb.append(' <ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
') sb.append(' <LEDGERNAME>' + esc(acctName) + '</LEDGERNAME>
') sb.append(' <ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>No</ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>
') sb.append(' <AMOUNT>' + amt + '</AMOUNT>
') sb.append(' </ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
') } }
sb.append(' </VOUCHER>
') sb.append(' </TALLYMESSAGE>
') }
sb.append(' </REQUESTDATA>
') sb.append(' </IMPORTDATA>
') sb.append(' </BODY>
') sb.append('</ENVELOPE>')
tallyXml = sb.toString()

service.description: Export GL accounts as Tally Ledger masters

actions.script:
def esc = { s -> (s ?: '').toString().replace('&','&').replace('<','<').replace('>','>') } def sb = new StringBuilder() sb.append('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
') sb.append('<ENVELOPE>
') sb.append(' <HEADER>
') sb.append(' <TALLYREQUEST>Import Data</TALLYREQUEST>
') sb.append(' </HEADER>
') sb.append(' <BODY>
') sb.append(' <IMPORTDATA>
') sb.append(' <REQUESTDESC>
') sb.append(' <REPORTNAME>All Masters</REPORTNAME>
') sb.append(' <STATICVARIABLES>
') sb.append(' <SVCURRENTCOMPANY>' + esc(companyName ?: 'Company') + '</SVCURRENTCOMPANY>
') sb.append(' </STATICVARIABLES>
') sb.append(' </REQUESTDESC>
') sb.append(' <REQUESTDATA>
')
def tallyGroupMap = [ 'ASSET': 'Current Assets', 'LIABILITY': 'Current Liabilities', 'EQUITY': 'Capital Account', 'REVENUE': 'Sales Accounts', 'EXPENSE': 'Purchase Accounts', 'INCOME': 'Direct Incomes', 'COST_OF_GOODS': 'Direct Expenses' ]
accounts?.each { acct -> def tallyGroup = tallyGroupMap[acct.accountClassification] ?: 'Sundry Debtors' sb.append(' <TALLYMESSAGE xmlns:UDF="TallyUDF">
') sb.append(' <LEDGER NAME="' + esc(acct.accountName ?: acct.glAccountId) + '" ACTION="Create">
') sb.append(' <PARENT>' + tallyGroup + '</PARENT>
') sb.append(' <OPENINGBALANCE>0</OPENINGBALANCE>
') sb.append(' </LEDGER>
') sb.append(' </TALLYMESSAGE>
') }
sb.append(' </REQUESTDATA>
') sb.append(' </IMPORTDATA>
') sb.append(' </BODY>
') sb.append('</ENVELOPE>')
tallyXml = sb.toString()
